title: Pepi I
description: King of Egypt's Dynasty 6. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (1637 BC ±2 years). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "Userkare goes from D6 to D12/13 and back to D6"
reign.note: Start of Pepi I's sole reign, at the end of Userkare's coregency. CFAH-5 gives "about 1646 to 1593 B.C." (see open question I7).

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "8. Sargon of Akkad and Pepi I"
reign.note: Counted from the death of Nitocris in 1479 B.C. with Manetho's 53 years. Superseded in practice by CFAH-6 (open question I7).

reign.date: Start Co-Rex: 1646; Start Sole-rex: 1637; End Sole-rex: 1606; Death or Deposition: 1593
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 16 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 6", p. 104
